text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A25, A26, A27, A28, A31 and the trio A36, A37, A42 each ran in every trace. In the later window, A25, A26, A28 and A31 still appear in every trace, but A27 appears in about 54 in 100 traces and A36, A37 and A42 in about 47 in 100 each. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- A27 and the trio became mutually exclusive: before, A27 co-occurred with each of A36, A37 and A42 in 100% of traces; in the later window they share a trace in about 1 in 100 cases or fewer, with A27 appearing without the trio in about 52–53 in 100 traces and the trio (all three together, in mixed order) appearing without A27 in about 47 in 100. [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL020, REL021, REL022]
- A25's successor changed completely: before, its outgoing transitions split almost evenly over A42 (about 35 in 100), A36 (about 34) and A37 (about 31); in the later window about 98 in 100 lead to A28, and A28 follows A25 within one step in about 98 in 100 traces, whereas before the gap had been about four steps in about 94 in 100 traces. [DIR001, LAG001]
- The trio's position relative to A28 and A26 flipped: before, each trio member preceded A28 in about 99–100 in 100 traces and preceded A26 in about 98–99 in 100; in the later window A28 precedes the trio and A26 precedes the trio in the roughly 47 in 100 traces where they co-occur. [REL006, REL007, REL008, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- A26's routing changed: before it led to A27 in about 97 in 100 of its outgoing transitions; in the later window about 52 in 100 lead to A27 and about 14–17 in 100 each to A36, A37 and A42. The block's exit changed accordingly: before, each trio member led mainly to the other trio members and to A28 (about 32 in 100), and A31 was reached after A27; in the later window each trio member leads to A31 in about 28–36 in 100 of its outgoing transitions. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL017, REL018, REL019]
- The distance from A26 to A31 changed from almost always two steps (about 97 in 100, via A27) to a split between two steps (about 51 in 100, via A27) and four steps (about 46 in 100, via the trio). Mean event positions moved consistently: A28 earlier (about 0.45 to 0.39 of the trace length), A26 earlier (about 0.60 to 0.54), and A36/A37/A42 later (about 0.40 to 0.58). [LAG005, POS002, POS004, POS006, POS007, POS008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the control flow around A27, A36, A37 and A42 was restructured from a fixed sequence into an exclusive choice placed after A26. In the earlier window every trace ran A25, then the trio A36/A37/A42 in mixed order, then A28, then A26, then A27, then A31; in the later window A25 passes directly to A28, A26 follows, and the process then takes one of two mutually exclusive branches — A27 alone, or the trio A36/A37/A42 together — each in roughly half the traces, with A31 remaining the common successor of both branches. [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL009, REL010, DIR001, DIR002, LAG001, LAG005]

The hypothesis rests on direct relational and successor evidence — the order flips between the trio and A26/A28, A25's near-exclusive successor A28 at distance one, and the collapse of co-occurrence between A27 and the trio — and it is consistent across the occurrence, direction and position indicators; with 50 qualifying items against roughly 0.7 expected without change, chance sampling cannot account for the pattern as a whole. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, LAG001, REL011, POS004, POS006]

The evidence shows pairwise order changes but cannot establish which block moved: reading it as A28 and A26 being moved ahead of the trio fits the data equally well, and it cannot be decided whether A28's repositioning and the introduction of the branch are one coordinated change or two simultaneous ones. A few LAG items rest on a single observation in one window and were not used. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG011]

Other differences: only minor position shifts accompany the restructuring — A25's mean position slightly later (about 0.34 to 0.36) and A31's slightly earlier (about 0.65 to 0.63) — with no other substantial behavioural difference at the configured thresholds. [POS001, POS005]
